Location: Chicago, IL
Job type: Full time
Posted: Posted 2 Days Ago

About Northern Trust

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.

With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.

Position Summary:
The role will support the Global Multi Asset team across investment research, thought leadership, and portfolio and product initiatives. The role combines asset allocation research and investment analysis with the ability to translate complex investment views into clear, compelling content for institutional and intermediary audiences.

Approximately 70% of the role will focus on developing content related to the team's multi-asset research and investment capabilities, while approximately 30% will focus on asset allocation and investment research, including support for the team's Tactical Asset Allocation (TAA) process and Investment Policy Committee (IPC).

The successful candidate will be analytically curious, highly organized, comfortable working with investment professionals, and particularly strong at translating research and portfolio insights into polished presentations, publications, and other client-facing materials.

Major Duties:

1. Create content related to multi-asset research and investment capabilities (70%)
2. Asset Allocation investment research (30%)
3. Support portfolio management and product management initiatives
4. Serve as a subject matter expert on creation of presentation decks and marketing collateral for thought leadership and research publications
5. Collaborate with key partners to support the monthly Investment Policy Committee (IPC) meetings
6. Facilitate discussions and implementation of IPC meetings
7. Carries out research tasks to support the team's tactical asset allocation process

Knowledge:

• Create, design and maintain complex presentation templates
• Ability to research investment opportunities
• Demonstrated ability to collaborate with teams to achieve objectives and meet deadlines
• Strong oral and written communication skills
• Highly flexible and adaptable to change
• MS Office suite proficiency, practical AI-implementation use cases

Experience:

• 2+ years of experience working in financial services (Asset Management and/or Fund Administration preferred)
· College or University degree required; Finance, Economics and/or Accounting experience required.

Salary Range:
$73,500 - 117,700 USD
Salary range is a good faith estimate of base pay. Northern Trust provides a comprehensive benefits package including retirement benefits (401k and pension), health and welfare benefits (medical, dental, vision, spending accounts and disability), paid time off, parental and caregiver leave, life & accident insurance, and other voluntary and well-being benefits.
